instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.

Maintain Clawdbot's compounding knowledge graph under life/areas/** by adding/superseding atomic facts (items.json), regenerating entity summaries (summary.md), and keeping IDs consistent. Use when you need deterministic updates to the kno.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the knowledge-graph skill.

- Enables safe, programmatic updates to Clawdbot's knowledge graph under life/areas/**.
- Add or supersede atomic facts for any entity via command-line scripts.
- Ensures fact IDs remain consistent and auto-increment per entity.
- Supports regenerating entity summaries from active facts.
- Removes the need for manual JSON edits; prevents deletion of facts by enforcing supersession.
